svg.title: Four levels of metrics
svg.desc: A block diagram of the course stack. A box "Planner or LLM agent" at the top, tag 1, has an arrow down to "Behavior tree and skills", tag 3, which has an arrow down to "ARIAC factory in Gazebo". An arrow goes from the factory to a box on the right, "Perception: lidar, camera, VLM", tag 2, which has arrows to the planner and to the behavior tree. An arrow goes from the factory to a box on the left, "ARIAC score table", tag 4.
